metadata.description: Spec-driven, autonomous delivery toolkit for TypeScript backend, React web and React Native mobile.

plugins.name: ccs-core
plugins.description: Spec workflow, autonomous run cycle, independent review, PR and HTML status report, plus safety hooks. Stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: ccs-backend-ts
plugins.description: TypeScript backend pack: API/DB design skills, Vitest + supertest recipes. Requires ccs-core.

plugins.name: ccs-web-react
plugins.description: React web pack: component/state/a11y skills, RTL + Playwright recipes. Requires ccs-core.

plugins.name: ccs-mobile-rn
plugins.description: React Native / Expo pack: skills, Jest + RNTL recipes, opt-in Maestro. Requires ccs-core.
